purpose: Hard constraint kept from E228: LOSO unknown rejection pinned at 0.90; maximise Test S2 acceptance. Single new route: retrain a light raw-EEG encoder from scratch inside every strict outer LOSO fold, using ONLY the enrolled identities' fit rows (trial fraction <= 0.6). Held identity never participates in training, early stopping or calibration. Ablate cross-session drift augmentation and waveform PGD adversarial training.

baseline.rule: An E229 candidate is an improvement only if LOSO rejection in [0.90, 0.91] AND Test S2 > 0.3042980539077948 AND separation AUC > 0.7918401795053043.

data.raw_cache_note: float32 memmap, written once, read-only reuse. Train is kept on GPU (about 1GB); Test is streamed in chunks.

protocol.blocks_rule: block = clip(int(frac * 5), 0, 4) per (subject, task) trial order
protocol.fit_rows: per outer fold: subjects != held identity AND frac <= 0.6 (6695 rows in total, about 6360 per fold)
protocol.evaluation_window: 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 (2301 rows); held identity appears only here

inner_oof.rule: tau needs known scores the encoder has NOT seen. Inside each fold a second encoder is trained on fit rows of blocks 0-1 only and scores fit rows of block 2 (frac in (0.4, 0.6]). The deploy/LOSO encoder is trained on all fit rows. This is the latest of the E228 inner-block folds (E228 averages its 3 blocks; here one block is used to keep the 20-fold budget under one hour). Deviation documented in report.md.

protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; reject if score < tau; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC.

encoder.architecture: Conv1d(18->32,k9,s2)-GroupNorm(8)-ELU -> Conv1d(32->64,k9,s2)-GroupNorm(8)-ELU -> Conv1d(64->64,k9,s2)-GroupNorm(8)-ELU -> global average pool -> Dropout -> Linear(64->64) -> L2 normalise
encoder.parameter_count: about 62k (conv 5184 + 18432 + 36864, head 4160, norms); well below the 200k budget
encoder.input_normalisation: per-trial per-channel mean removal, then divide by the whole-trial global RMS (differentiable, computed inside forward, no cross-sample statistics)
encoder.classifier: Linear(64 -> n_enrolled_identities), bias=True, trained only, never used for scoring

train.supcon: positives = other trials of the same subject inside the batch; temperature 0.1; L2-normalised embeddings
train.early_stop: none (no held-identity data is used for stopping; fixed epochs)

drift.spectral_tilt_note: rfft magnitude reweight (f/f_nyq + 0.05)^alpha, alpha ~ U(-0.5, 0.5) per trial, weights normalised to mean 1
drift.crop_resample: circular shift then random crop to L in [0.9*1200, 1200], linear interpolate back to 1200
drift.random_rereference: subtract one randomly chosen channel per trial

adversarial.ratio_note: 30% of each batch is replaced by a PGD adversarial copy inside the loss; the clean 70% is still used
adversarial.eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS; eps drawn per batch from the two values
adversarial.objective: maximise cross-entropy of the identity classifier (identity confusion)
adversarial.domain: train-split only (fit rows of enrolled identities), never held identity

scoring.prototypes: per (task, identity) k-means on fit-row embeddings; k=12 for the main candidates, k=1 (centroid) for the k1 candidate
scoring.score: -min euclidean distance to same-task prototypes (L2-normalised embedding space)
scoring.threshold: tau(A) = (1-A) quantile of inner-OOF known scores, A bisected on the Train side until pooled micro LOSO unknown rejection equals 0.90

constraint.calibration: bisect A on the Train side; keep the loosest A whose pooled LOSO unknown rejection is still >= 0.90
constraint.selection: highest Test S2 among candidates whose LOSO rejection lies in the accepted band
constraint.one_extra_round: at most one follow-up round (augmentation strength or k); not used unless the first round is close

official_note: Official Test AUC/F1 = N/A: Test has no identity labels.
bias_note: Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65. Calibration, augmentation, adversarial and candidate definitions are frozen in this config before the run and use Train rows only; the final candidate comparison reads Test, so the reported S2 gap carries an evaluation bias.

runtime.expected: about 10-20s per encoder; 2 encoders per fold and regime; 20 folds x 3 regimes x 2 = 120 trainings
runtime.guard: if the 3-fold smoke projects > 60 min, log that in run.log before the full run
